description:
swissrailways helps you find and buy the right Swiss travel pass for your trip.

Whether you want unlimited travel across Switzerland’s trains, boats, and public transport network, or a discount card for occasional journeys, the app guides you through the available Swiss Travel Pass products in ChatGPT.

Compare Swiss Travel Pass, Swiss Travel Pass Flex, and Swiss Half Fare Card options based on your travel dates, itinerary, and traveler details. Configure tickets for one or multiple travelers, choose comfort class and duration, apply available discounts such as the Swiss Family Card, and review the total price in CHF, EUR, GBP, or USD.

When you are ready to buy, swissrailways generates a secure checkout link from Switzerland Travel Centre. Payment is completed outside ChatGPT on Switzerland Travel Centre’s secure checkout page, so no card details are entered in ChatGPT.

Swiss Travel Pass products are available only to travelers residing outside Switzerland.

Powered by Switzerland Travel Centre.
